state: S=(e,C) as frozen in Stage A
local_incidence_theorem: An origin-star elementary triangle C has exactly two primitive edges incident to O_E. For a state (e,C), one is the current segment edge e and there is a unique other radial edge e_next(C,e).
successor_construction: Let D be the unique elementary triangle other than C incident to e_next. Define NEXT(e,C)={(e_next,D)}.

candidate_exclusions.across_current_edge_e: excluded because it immediately undoes the chosen side-cell sweep rather than continuing through C
candidate_exclusions.across_opposite_nonorigin_edge: excluded because the shared edge is not incident to O_E and therefore cannot be the next fixed-origin one-step segment edge

AQ_baseline_relation: AQ N3(C) has three cell-neighbors; segment-edge incidence legitimately removes two of them before the escape score is applied
D6_reversal: the rule is incidence-defined and commutes with D6; exchanging side orientation reverses the six-state traversal
